lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: The same review round also recorded a non-blocking SUGGESTION (test/ui/tab-bar.test.tsx:137) that the new describe block's comment/label says 'CAM-241/316' but this issue is actually CAM-326. Cosmetic mislabel, no story was filed for it in this round, left untouched (out of scope for US-R1-001, which only covers the WARNING finding).
nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the reviewer WARNING at test/ui/tab-bar.test.tsx:185 (suspended={true} negative test): `waitForFrame(lastFrame, () => true, { timeoutMs: 200 })` short-circuited on the always-true predicate (returns after 0 macrotask ticks), so a suspension regression's not-yet-flushed onChange state update would slip past the assertion undetected. Changed the predicate to `() => false` so waitForFrame genuinely polls (bounded by timeoutMs=200) before the content-persistence assertion runs, giving a real regression a chance to flush and get caught. src/ui/TabBar.tsx was NOT touched (test-only fix). All gates green: typecheck, bun test (4867 pass / 0 fail), check:all spine.
